lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible. The central row posterior to the gills contains the largest and most distinct local maxima, arranged in a quasi-linear sequence with roughly equidistant spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical columns of elevated luminance intersect the horizontal rows, particularly visible in the mid-flank area, creating a grid of anchor nodes where spots are centered within these intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a light-colored dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a dense population of smaller, high-contrast spots that decrease in size and increase in spatial frequency toward the distal trailing edge.
